_comment: P6 evaluation personas (answers.json format). Expected genres, themes and relevant books were fixed BEFORE running the recommender. Free texts avoid titles and obvious keywords of the expected books. Distinct from the 8 tuning personas of data/reference/personas_p4.json. A relevant work may have several book_ids (editions left in the catalogue): any of them counts. The work described in free_text.loved_book (a book the user has ALREADY read) is stored in expected.loved_book_work and is NOT counted as relevant: this rule was fixed from the loved_book texts only, after a first run showed that these descriptions favoured lexical methods.

personas.name: Children's fantasy adventure

free_text.ideal_book: An exciting adventure for a ten-year-old where an ordinary kid suddenly learns they have hidden powers and is taken to a secret world full of mythical creatures, friendship and danger.
free_text.loved_book: My son loved a story about a boy who did not fit in at school until he discovered who his real parents were and went on a quest with two loyal friends.
free_text.atmosphere: Magical, funny and full of wonder, with a bit of danger but nothing too scary.
free_text.avoid: Nothing violent or sad, no romance.

paraphrases: A thrilling story for a young reader in which a normal child discovers secret magical abilities and enters a hidden world of legendary beasts, loyal friends and peril.
A kid who thought they were nobody special finds out they have extraordinary gifts and is drawn into an enchanted realm of mythical monsters and brave companions.
An action-packed tale for children: an everyday boy or girl uncovers unknown powers and travels to a concealed land of fabulous creatures, friendship and risk.

relevant.title: Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone

personas.name: Dark Nordic crime thriller

free_text.ideal_book: A cold, slow-burning investigation where a tired, troubled detective uncovers corruption and violence hidden behind a quiet and orderly society.
free_text.loved_book: I loved a story about a damaged hacker and a journalist digging into a powerful family's buried crimes.
free_text.atmosphere: Freezing winters, long dark nights and small isolated towns in the far north of Europe.
free_text.avoid: Nothing cosy or comedic, no romance at the centre.

paraphrases: A bleak police procedural in which a weary, haunted inspector exposes brutality and corruption beneath the calm surface of a well-ordered country.
A grim, patient mystery where a worn-out officer with personal demons reveals the rot and cruelty concealed inside a peaceful, tidy nation.
A chilly, methodical detective story: an exhausted investigator with a dark past brings to light the violence and abuse of power behind a respectable society.

loved_book_work.title: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo

personas.name: Sweeping historical romance

free_text.ideal_book: A passionate love story between a strong-willed woman and a man from a very different world, set two or three centuries ago, with rebellion, danger and family loyalties tearing them apart.
free_text.loved_book: I adored a novel where a proud young woman slowly falls for a man she first despised, against the background of class differences and social change.
free_text.atmosphere: Romantic and sweeping, with old manors, wild landscapes and the weight of history.

paraphrases: An epic romance set long ago between a fiery, independent heroine and a man from another background, caught up in uprisings, peril and divided families.
A period love story where a determined woman and a man from a completely different life are pulled apart by revolt, threats and clan loyalties.
A grand tale of love in a past century: a headstrong lady and an outsider struggle against rebellion, risk and the demands of their kin.

personas.name: Young adult dystopia

free_text.ideal_book: A teenage girl lives in a future society where the rulers control every part of people's lives, until she is forced into a deadly test and decides to fight back.
free_text.loved_book: I loved a book about a sixteen-year-old who discovers that her perfect, peaceful community hides a terrible secret about how it keeps everyone in line.
free_text.atmosphere: Tense, oppressive, a ruined or rigidly controlled world in the future.
free_text.avoid: No slow philosophical books, no adult romance.

paraphrases: In a coming world ruled by an all-controlling regime, a young girl is thrown into a lethal trial and chooses to rebel.
A teenager growing up under a tyrannical government that dictates everything is made to compete for her life and starts a revolt.
Set in a future where those in power regulate every aspect of existence, an adolescent heroine faces a murderous challenge and resists.

personas.name: Literary psychological novel

free_text.ideal_book: A disturbing inner portrait of someone who commits a terrible act and is slowly eaten up by guilt and paranoia; I want to live inside a troubled mind.
free_text.loved_book: I was fascinated by a novel narrated by a bitter, isolated man who spends the whole book justifying himself and attacking society.
free_text.atmosphere: Claustrophobic, feverish, a grey city and sleepless nights.
free_text.avoid: No light entertainment, no happy endings, no romance.

paraphrases: A troubling psychological study of a person who does something unforgivable and is gradually consumed by remorse and suspicion, seen from inside their head.
An unsettling journey into the mind of a character who has done something monstrous and cannot escape the torment of conscience and fear.
A dark introspective novel following someone who commits a dreadful deed, then sinks into guilt, anxiety and obsession.

relevant.title: We Need to Talk about Kevin

personas.name: Cosy mystery

free_text.ideal_book: A gentle whodunit in a peaceful village where a curious, kind-hearted amateur sleuth solves a murder through clever observation, more puzzle than bloodshed.
free_text.loved_book: I loved a story about a warm, wise woman who sets up her own little investigation business and sorts out her neighbours' problems with common sense.
free_text.atmosphere: Comforting and charming, a small community, cups of tea and friendly gossip.
free_text.avoid: No graphic violence, no gore, nothing too dark.

paraphrases: A light-hearted murder puzzle set in a quiet little town, where a friendly, nosy amateur investigator cracks the case through sharp wits rather than violence.
A soothing detective story in a sleepy village: a good-natured non-professional sleuth unravels a killing with careful deduction and no blood.
A charming small-town mystery where an inquisitive, gentle hobby detective figures out who did it by noticing small details.

personas.name: Memoir of hardship

free_text.ideal_book: A true story told by the person who lived it: growing up poor and as an outsider, facing racism and hardship, and telling it with humour despite the pain.
free_text.loved_book: I was moved by the real-life account of a woman who survived a traumatic childhood in the segregated South and found her voice through books.
free_text.atmosphere: Honest, intimate, sometimes funny and sometimes heartbreaking.

paraphrases: An autobiography about a childhood of poverty and exclusion, confronting prejudice and adversity, narrated with wit in spite of the suffering.
A first-person non-fiction account of growing up deprived and different, battling discrimination and difficulty, told with a sense of humour.
The author's own life story: a poor, marginalised upbringing, racial injustice and struggle, recounted with jokes as well as grief.

loved_book_work.title: I Know Why the Caged Bird Sings

personas.name: Supernatural horror, favourite author excluded

free_text.ideal_book: A slow-building supernatural terror in an old house where something evil seems to be watching a family, more psychological dread than gore.
free_text.loved_book: I loved a novel about a writer who takes a winter job looking after an empty mountain hotel with his wife and son and slowly goes mad.
free_text.atmosphere: Creepy, claustrophobic and unsettling, with whispers in the dark and a growing sense of possession.
free_text.avoid: No zombies, no splatter, no comedy.

paraphrases: A creeping ghostly horror story set in an ancient mansion where a malevolent presence stalks a family, relying on fear of the mind rather than blood.
A gradual, eerie tale of the supernatural: a household is haunted by a sinister force in an old home, building dread instead of gore.
Quiet but terrifying paranormal fiction about a family menaced by an evil spirit in a decaying house, all atmosphere and psychological fear.

personas.name: 19th-century social novel

free_text.ideal_book: A long, rich nineteenth-century English novel about provincial society, social class and money, with many characters whose fates slowly intertwine.
free_text.loved_book: I loved a classic about an idealistic young woman who makes an unhappy marriage and learns to live with her choices in a small English town.
free_text.atmosphere: Elegant old-fashioned prose, country towns, drawing rooms and industrial cities in England.
free_text.avoid: No modern settings, no fast thrillers.

paraphrases: A big, detailed English classic from the 1800s depicting life in a country town, class divisions and fortunes, with a large cast whose stories gradually connect.
A sprawling Victorian-era novel portraying provincial English communities, rank and wealth through many intertwined lives.
A thick period novel of nineteenth-century England about the gentry, the poor and money, following numerous characters whose destinies cross.

personas.name: Feel-good novel

free_text.ideal_book: An uplifting, funny and tender story about a grumpy or socially awkward loner whose life is transformed by unexpected friendships with quirky people around them.
free_text.loved_book: I loved a book about a lonely widower who wants to end it all until a noisy new family moves in next door and keeps interrupting him.
free_text.atmosphere: Warm, heartwarming and gently humorous, the kind of book that makes you smile and cry.
free_text.avoid: No violence, no crime, nothing bleak.

paraphrases: A heartwarming comic novel about a cranky, solitary misfit whose world changes thanks to surprising bonds with eccentric neighbours.
A cheerful, moving tale of an awkward, lonely person who is slowly opened up by an unlikely circle of odd and kind friends.
A tender, amusing story where a bad-tempered recluse rediscovers joy through the unexpected warmth of a few colourful strangers.
